g.text: A roadmap decision becomes dangerous when evidence changes
but the commitment does not.
A continuous PM loop chains evidence, alignment, execution,
outcome monitoring, and reusable memory.
Five independent Google ADK agents inspect customer, usage,
strategy, feasibility, and challenger evidence.
Gemini preserves citations and disagreement.
The council rejects a universal rollout.
Ship, rollback, segment, and defer expose their tradeoffs
before anyone commits.
The model recommends; a named human authorizes
one falsifiable, reversible experiment.
Bounded internal allocation · Decision state only
External writes: none
One approval starts the monitor.
There is no second prompt or PM action.
The guardrail breaks, the allocation rolls back,
and generation 2 reopens automatically.
Evidence, dissent, approval, result, and lineage stay linked.
A fresh human approval is required.
Firebase Hosting → Cloud Run + Firestore
Google ADK + Gemini · BigQuery · Cloud Tasks
Ten deterministic checks cover provenance, independence,
human authority, the operating loop, and calibrated memory.
UNRELEASED LOCAL CANDIDATE · NOT PRODUCTION PROOF
Final take must match public main, health, build, digest, and live trace.
Judges can compare the working screen, health metadata,
repository, build, and architecture instead of trusting a claim.
Driftline: evidence, dissent, decision, outcome.
https://driftline-ops.web.app/
